description: This PHP class defines a DataTransferObject `DataGroupPermission` for representing user role permissions within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It encapsulates permissions such as read, create, update, delete, and self, and provides methods for instantiation from an array, as well as getters for each permission aspect.
external_files: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/ (License info, but no direct external file referenced)

classes.name: DataGroupPermission
classes.description: A data transfer object representing user role permissions (read, create, update, delete, self) within the HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the permission object with role and permission flags.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance of DataGroupPermission from an associative array describing the role and permissions.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Returns the user role associated with the permission object.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether the role has read permission.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether the role has create permission.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether the role has update permission.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether the role has delete permission.

methods.name: isSelf
methods.description: Returns whether the permission is self-referential.
